_doc: Rules consumed by ~/.claude/hooks/gsd-staleness-monitor.js (Stop hook). When git status shows files matching `if_touched`, the listed `remind_about` items surface to the model as a systemMessage. Reminders are NOT enforcement; they nudge. Patterns: * = any chars except /, ** = any chars including /. Edit freely; the hook re-reads on each fire.

Unlinked memories are invisible: confirm MEMORY.md index has a one-line entry for any NEW memory file

Confirm CLAUDE.md remains under 200 lines (its own discipline rule)
Confirm no pictographic emoji were added (feedback_no_emoji_in_files.md)

Test the new rule by touching a matching file in a scratch commit and observing the next Stop fire
